title: Active-drainage MODFLOW6 tangent closure

canonical.relevant_delta_since_f_gc30: NO_SRC_RUNTIME_SOLVER_TRANSACTION_DELTA; only publication P2E08 files in the observed 10-commit advancement

objective: Close only the active-drainage derivative coverage needed by the already-admitted MODFLOW6 SWAP predictor-response contract, without reopening F-GC30 or changing the frozen Drainage-v1 denominator.

reconcile_findings.production_drainage_tangent: Per-level drainage response already exposes derivative_defined and dq_dgroundwater_level; the missing chain is qbot -> accepted hydraulic state -> groundwater_level -> next-step drainage response -> later hydraulic state.
reconcile_findings.serialized_runtime_order: Active drainage is evaluated from request/base-state groundwater_level before a Richards trial and is held fixed during that solve.
reconcile_findings.current_groundwater_level_lifecycle: The serialized reference state binding seeds solver gwl from the incoming physical state; inspected HeadCalc code does not generally recompute gwl on the prescribed-qbot route, and the candidate state receives the solver gwl value.
reconcile_findings.legacy_order: Legacy SWAP ordering is Drainage -> SoilWater(2) -> accepted/retry resolution -> SoilWater(3); SoilWater(3) calls calcgwl, so the newly derived groundwater level becomes input to the next physical step rather than an implicit within-solve drainage update.
reconcile_findings.drainage_v1_governance: F-PM19/F-TB12 define Drainage-v1 100-percent completion for a frozen eight-variant denominator and explicitly do not require fully implicit drainage-response solver coupling. F-GC32 is a new coupling sensitivity capability, not a reopening of Drainage-v1.
reconcile_findings.zero_derivative_disposition: FORBIDDEN_AS_WORKAROUND: setting d(gwl)/d(qbot)=0 would encode the currently frozen technical state value as scientific truth before the exact calcgwl-derived-state semantics are qualified.
